evidence: Modifies `BufferedWriter` in `src/streams.h` to avoid throwing in destructors on write failure.
rationale: Prevents `std::terminate` crashes on disk write errors by handling buffered stream write failures outside the destructor. When disk writes fail (such as on a full filesystem), `AutoFile::write_buffer()` throws, and relying on `BufferedWriter`'s destructor triggered uncatchable termination without clean diagnostic logs.
